name: test
description: Shared test scene: platform with ledge and ramp, pit, bulkhead wall, flying hornet, lamp + torch, dark hangar group.

Bless.name: Bless
Bless.description: Bless an ally: +2 to attack rolls for 10 turns.

Burning_Hands.name: Burning Hands
Burning_Hands.description: A thin sheet of flame shoots from your fingertips in a 3-tile cone. Dexterity save for half. Allies in the cone get burned too.

Cure_Wounds.name: Cure Wounds
Cure_Wounds.description: Touch a creature to restore d8 + casting bonus HP (+d8 per slot level above 1st).

Fire_Bolt.name: Fire Bolt
Fire_Bolt.description: Hurl a mote of fire. A tier 3 hit sets the target Burning.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: A bead of fire blossoms into a radius-2 explosion up to 8 tiles away. Dexterity save for half; a tier 3 failure leaves targets Burning.

Guiding_Bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
Guiding_Bolt.description: A flash of light that leaves the target Illuminated (-2 AC) until the end of its next turn.

Hold_Person.name: Hold Person
Hold_Person.description: Wisdom save or the target is Held in place (no movement) until the end of its next turn.

Lightning_Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning_Bolt.description: A 10-tile line of lightning blasts out from you toward your aim. Dexterity save for half.

Magic_Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic_Missile.description: Three glowing darts that always strike their target: 3d4 + 3 force damage, +1d4 per slot level above 1st.

Mass_Healing_Word.name: Mass Healing Word
Mass_Healing_Word.description: Words of restoration heal every ally within a radius-2 burst up to 8 tiles away.

Ray_of_Frost.name: Ray of Frost
Ray_of_Frost.description: A frigid beam that Chills the target, cutting its movement by 2 until the end of its next turn.

Sacred_Flame.name: Sacred Flame
Sacred_Flame.description: Radiant flame descends on a creature that fails a Dexterity save.

Shatter.name: Shatter
Shatter.description: A painful ringing noise. Constitution save; half damage on a success.

Shield_of_Faith.name: Shield of Faith
Shield_of_Faith.description: A shimmering field grants an ally +2 AC for 10 turns.

Thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
Thunderclap.description: A burst of thunder around you. Every enemy adjacent to you makes a Constitution save.

Thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
Thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Constitution save for half. Hits everyone adjacent, friend or foe.
